text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Clear skies were forecasted, but 
should I buy an umbrella on the way back?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I hear that Japan's weather 
forecasting is remarkably accurate."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let's choose to believe that for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, the weather grew even worse, and 
finally—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Agh, honestly! It wasn't supposed to 
rain...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pelted by the rain, Eishin Flash's spirits 
sank both physically and mentally...
